verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Stripe's Subscriptions API, CLI, and a no-code migration toolkit that can import/migrate many subscriptions at once, which supports bulk-style automation, but there is no explicit documentation of dedicated batch/bulk endpoints or bulk update operations across arbitrary item sets. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints, documented examples of scripting bulk create/update/delete across many objects, and independent confirmation of bulk operation reliability.
